August 18, 2026: $SPX held near its highs at 7,691.76 while the SKEW Index stood at 143.6.

Tail-risk pricing remains elevated beneath a strong index, but that alone does not signal an imminent decline.

If SKEW remains above 140 while SPX holds near its highs, index strength continues to coexist with elevated tail-risk pricing. A move below 130 would show that concern is easing.

Track tail-risk pricing beneath the S&P 500 with the SKEW Index via SentimenTrader’s Light Data API: https://t.co/xxRX5UzgB1

tweets.text: This is in one of those semi-rare $BTC volatility squeezes, and what comes next could be cycle-defining. The data below shows that Upside breaks have been more reliable in terms of follow-through. Downside breaks have been mixed - we have already seen 2 continuations since the Oct peak, but looking further back to 2018 and '22, major lows formed and fuelled a capitulation decline after this signal fired. Yes, tiny sample size.
